bottleneck.description: Chinese Academy of Sciences-spin-off integrator (~6% China share) across industrial, mobile, and cobot lines.

dependency.key_customers: Chinese discrete-manufacturing customers, AGV/AMR deployments for warehousing
dependency.key_suppliers: Domestic motors/drives plus imported reducers and controllers

editorial.notes: Siasun is a top-5 Chinese robot vendor (~6.2% domestic share) with strong policy ties but trails Estun and Inovance, and broadly competes against Big-4 incumbents in China. Customers have full substitution paths. No bottleneck position.
